extraction.Name: Josephine Collins
extraction.Buyer: not stated (seller states he purchased a quarter section of land from her years ago; buyer's name not stated in document)
extraction.NOTES: Document is a copy of a letter dated July 2, 1929, from V. H. Tackett to Mr. J. E. McKean, Supt., Rosebud, S.D. Tackett states he purchased a quarter section of land in Gregory County from Josephine Collins years ago and that she now claims she did not receive all of the purchase price. Tackett denies the accusation and states he has met with both Mrs. Collins and her husband at least fifty times since the transaction without any such claim being raised. Also references a Peter Bordeaux making a similar claim. Tackett states he is unable to locate relevant files but may have something in Omaha. He met Mrs. Collins at Winner Hospital the previous month and interpreted for her but she made no mention of the claim at that time. | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 2862.5 sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research, 2026-05-04). CAT_3 record — Sonnet text extraction captured the allottee Name but not the Allotment number; this patch backfills the allotment.
